cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

mechanism: A steadies its former planning pupil by revealing a venue change, lost building and fire in stages while recasting the original reassurance about the date.
confusable: Not concealing A fault to evade blame: A parcels bad news to protect B ability to cope and offers practical support as its severity emerges.
comparison: Lost wedding venue versus shattered sentimental gnome.
seedUse: D231 venue small change/date available/building/fire/next; S05 planning under pressure.
